verdict.rationale: Brex says finance teams can set rules for spending, documentation, and approvers, which Brex AI applies to every transaction (brex-docs-8). It also offers auto-enforced limits by category such as stipends, travel, and procurement (brex-docs-9, brex-docs-36, brex-docs-39), and a review agent that auto-approves low-risk expenses and escalates exceptions to humans (brex-docs-16, brex-docs-41). Spend limits are also manageable through the Budgets API (brex-docs-5). Missing for 10: role-based expense policy limits are not explicitly documented (role-based routing appears only for bill pay), there is no in-depth documentation of the policy rule model or what context rules can express, and there is no independent or hands-on corroboration of exception-only auto-approval.
